about.description:
MarkupSafe implements a text object that escapes characters so it is
safe to use in HTML and XML. Characters that have special meanings are
replaced so that they display as the actual characters. This mitigates
injection attacks, meaning untrusted user input can safely be displayed
on a page.
about.summary: Safely add untrusted strings to HTML/XML markup.

raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  name: markupsafe
  version: "3.0.4"

package:
  name: markupsafe
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://files.pythonhosted.org/packages/source/${{ name[0] }}/${{ name }}/${{ name }}-${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 2e9ad7dd851bf45fab9f75cbff4cb493fee9979e8d8c7c9c3ee119022518edd6

build:
  number: 1
  noarch: ${{ "python" if use_noarch }}
  variant:
    down_prioritize_variant: ${{ 1 if use_noarch else 0 }}
  script:
    - if: use_noarch
      then: sed -i.bak 's/supports_speedups = /supports_speedups = False and /g' setup.py
    - ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv --no-deps --no-build-isolation

requirements:
  build:
    - if: build_platform != target_platform and not use_noarch
      then:
        - python
        - cross-python_${{ target_platform }}
    - if: not use_noarch
      then:
        - ${{ compiler('c') }}
        - ${{ stdlib("c") }}
  host:
    - if: use_noarch
      then: python ${{ python_min }}.*
      else: python
    - pip
    - setuptools >=77
  run:
    - if: use_noarch
      then: python >=${{ python_min }}
      else: python
  run_constraints:
    - jinja2 >=3.0.0

tests:
  - if: use_noarch
    then:
      - python:
          imports:
            - markupsafe
          pip_check: true
          python_version: ${{ python_min }}.*
    else:
      - python:
          imports:
            - markupsafe
          pip_check: true

about:
  license: BSD-3-Clause
  license_file: LICENSE.txt
  summary: Safely add untrusted strings to HTML/XML markup.
  description: |
    MarkupSafe implements a text object that escapes characters so it is
    safe to use in HTML and XML. Characters that have special meanings are
    replaced so that they display as the actual characters. This mitigates
    injection attacks, meaning untrusted user input can safely be displayed
    on a page.
  homepage: https://www.palletsprojects.com/p/markupsafe
  repository: https://github.com/pallets/markupsafe
  documentation: https://markupsafe.palletsprojects.com/

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - xylar
    - pelson
    - scopatz
    - ocefpaf
